yogaRoutines.targetBenefit: Whole body energy, spinal mobility & respiratory circulation
yogaRoutines.instructions: Perform 6 to 8 slow, gentle cycles on an empty stomach in the morning.
Alternate 3 sets of Cobra pose and Child's pose, breathing deeply into lower back.

yogaRoutines.targetBenefit: Clears nasal pathways, allergy relief & mental calm
yogaRoutines.instructions: Sit comfortably with upright spine. Inhale through left nostril, exhale through right. Repeat 12 cycles.

prescriptions.advice: Hydrate adequately (at least 2.5-3 liters of warm water daily). Avoid chilled drinks. Do not skip meals before taking medication.
